name: Deloitte
aliases: Deloitte Consulting;Deloitte South Africa;Deloitte (South Africa);Deloitte & Touche;Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu
note_append: The roster records 13 people at Deloitte Consulting. Deloitte's own site presents consulting as one of the firm's service lines rather than a separate company, so it is recorded as an alias here, which resolves those people to this firm instead of leaving them on an unclaimed employer string.
evidence: Deloitte's South African site presents audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory and tax as services of one firm.

name: Peninsula Beverages
note_append: The roster writes this bottler as Coca-Cola Peninsula Beverages in places and Peninsula Beverages in others. They are one Western Cape Coca-Cola bottler, so the longer name is kept as an alias rather than as a second employer.
evidence: Peninsula Beverages' own site trades as Coca-Cola Peninsula Beverages, the Coca-Cola bottler for the Western Cape.

name: Scatec South Africa
note_append: Scatec ASA is the Norwegian parent and Scatec South Africa is the local operation. The roster uses both spellings for the same people, so ASA is kept as an alias on this record; the parent relationship itself is not asserted here because no source read so far states the ownership structure.
evidence: Scatec describes its business as renewable energy project development, construction and operation across several markets.

name: Macsteel
aliases: Macsteel Service Centres SA;Macsteel Service Centres
note_append: Macsteel Service Centres SA is the trading name the steel merchant uses for its service-centre business; the roster's shorter 'Macsteel' and the longer form are one company, so the longer form is an alias.
evidence: Macsteel's own site presents its service centre network as its trading operation in South Africa.

name: Pepkor
aliases: Pepkor Holdings;Pepkor NexTech;Pepkor Lifestyle;Pepkor Payments and Lending
note_append: The roster splits Pepkor people across Pepkor Holdings, Pepkor NexTech, Pepkor Lifestyle and Pepkor Payments and Lending. Pepkor reports these as divisions of one listed group, so they are recorded as aliases here and their people resolve to the group rather than to four unclaimed employer strings. If any of them is later shown to be a separate legal entity, it should become its own record with a corporate relationship instead of an alias.
evidence: Pepkor's own site describes the group as a portfolio of retail brands and operating divisions rather than separate companies.
